sn35.88:1.1: atha kho āyasmā puṇṇo yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami …pe… ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā puṇṇo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
sn35.88:1.2: sādhu me bhante bhagavā saṅkhittena dhammaṃ desetu yamahaṃ bhagavato dhammaṃ sutvā eko vūpakaṭṭho appamatto ātāpī pahitatto vihareyyanti.
sn35.88:2.1: santi kho puṇṇa cakkhuviññeyyā rūpā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasañhitā rajaniyā
sn35.88:2.2: tañce bhikkhu abhinandati abhivadati ajjhosāya tiṭṭhati
sn35.88:2.3: tassa taṃ abhinandato abhivadato ajjhosāya tiṭṭhato uppajjati nandi

sn35.88:4.1: iminā tvaṃ puṇṇa ārakā so imasmā dhammavinayāti. evaṃ vutte aññataro bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca etthāhaṃ bhante anassāsaṃ ahaṃ hi bhante channaṃ phassāyatanānaṃ samudayañca atthaṅgamañca assādañca ādīnavañca nissaraṇañca yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāmīti. taṃ kiṃ maññasi bhikkhu. cakkhuṃ netaṃ mama nesohamasmi na meso attāti samanupassasīti. evaṃ bhante. sādhu bhikkhu ettha ca te bhikkhu cakkhuṃ netaṃ mama nesohamasmi na meso attāti evametaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya sudiṭṭhaṃ bhavissati evante etaṃ paṭhamaṃ phassāyatanaṃ pahīnaṃ bhavissati āyatiṃ apunabbhavāya …pe… jivhaṃ netaṃ mama nesohamasmi na meso attāti samanupassasīti. evaṃ bhante. sādhu bhikkhu tattha te bhikkhu jivhā netaṃ mama nesohamasmi na meso attāti evametaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya sudiṭṭhaṃ bhavissati evaṃ te etaṃ catutthaṃ phassāyatanaṃ pahīnaṃ bhavissati āyatiṃ apunabbhavāya …pe… manaṃ netaṃ mama nesohamasmi na meso attāti samanupassasīti. evaṃ bhante …pe… sādhu puṇṇa mayā saṅkhittena ovādena ovadito katamasmiṃ janapade viharissasīti.
sn35.88:4.2: atthi bhante sunāparanto nāma janapado tatthāhaṃ viharissāmīti.
sn35.88:5.3: sace taṃ puṇṇa sunāparantakā manussā akkosissanti paribhāsissanti tatra te puṇṇa kinti bhavissatīti.
sn35.88:6.1: sace maṃ bhante sunāparantakā manussā akkosissanti paribhāsissanti tatra me evaṃ bhavissati
sn35.88:6.2: bhaddakā vatime sunāparantakā manussā subhaddakā vatime sunāparantakā manussā yaṃ maṃ nayime pāṇinā pahāraṃ dentīti
sn35.88:7.1: sace pana te puṇṇa sunāparantakā manussā pāṇinā pahāraṃ dassanti tatra pana te puṇṇa kinti bhavissatīti.
sn35.88:8.1: sace me bhante sunāparantakā manussā pāṇinā pahāraṃ dassanti tatra me evaṃ bhavissati

sn35.88:9.1: sace pana te puṇṇa sunāparantakā manussā leṇḍunā pahāraṃ dassanti tatra pana te puṇṇa kinti bhavissatīti.
sn35.88:10.1: sace me bhante sunāparantakā manussā leṇḍunā pahāraṃ dassanti tatra me evaṃ bhavissati

sn35.88:11.1: sace pana te puṇṇa sunāparantakā manussā daṇḍena pahāraṃ dassanti tatra pana te puṇṇa kinti bhavissatīti.
sn35.88:12.1: sace me bhante sunāparantakā manussā daṇḍena pahāraṃ dassanti tatra me evaṃ bhavissati
sn35.88:12.2: bhaddakā vatime sunāparantakā manussā subhaddakā vatime sunāparantakā manussā yaṃ maṃ nayime satthena pahāraṃ dentīti
sn35.88:13.1: sace pana te puṇṇa sunāparantakā manussā satthena pahāraṃ dassanti tatra pana te puṇṇa kinti bhavissatīti.
sn35.88:14.1: sace me bhante sunāparantakā manussā satthena pahāraṃ dassanti tatra me evaṃ bhavissati
sn35.88:14.2: bhaddakā vatime sunāparantakā manussā subhaddakā vatime sunāparantakā manussā yaṃ maṃ nayime tiṇhena satthena jīvitā voropentīti
sn35.88:15.1: sace pana te puṇṇa sunāparantakā manussā tiṇhena satthena jīvitā voropessanti tatra pana te puṇṇa kinti bhavissatīti.
sn35.88:16.1: sace me bhante sunāparantakā manussā tiṇhena satthena jīvitā voropessanti tatra me evaṃ bhavissati
sn35.88:16.2: santi kho tassa bhagavato sāvakā kāyena ca jīvitena ca aṭṭiyamānā harāyamānā jigucchamānā satthahārakaṃ pariyesanti taṃ me idaṃ pariyiṭṭhaññeva satthahārakaṃ laddhanti
sn35.88:17.2: sikkhissasi tvaṃ puṇṇa iminā damūpasamena samannāgato sunāparantasmiṃ janapade vatthuṃ
sn35.88:18.1: atha kho āyasmā puṇṇo bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinanditvā anumoditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā senāsanaṃ saṃsāmetvā pattacīvaraṃ ādāya yena sunāparanto janapado tena cārikaṃ pakkāmi
sn35.88:18.2: anupubbena cārikaṃ caramāno yena sunāparanto janapado tadavasari.
sn35.88:18.3: tatra sudaṃ āyasmā puṇṇo sunāparantasmiṃ janapade viharati.
sn35.88:18.4: atha kho āyasmā puṇṇo teneva antaravassena pañcamattāni upāsakasatāni paṭidesesi
sn35.88:19.1: atha kho sambahulā bhikkhu yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu ekamantaṃ nisinnā kho te bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavocuṃ
sn35.88:19.2: yo so bhante puṇṇo nāma kulaputto bhagavatā saṅkhittena ovādena ovadito so kālakato
sn35.88:20.1: paṇḍito bhikkhave puṇṇo kulaputto ahosi saccavādī dhammassānudhammaṃ na ca dhammādhikaraṇaṃ vihesesi
